findings.summary: The generated region now lists check-module.sh as present in scripts/, but the hand-maintained paragraph four lines below still lists it under "Not yet existing, and named by skills and standards that say so". AGENTS.md contradicts itself within one screen, and the false half is the half agents are told to obey.
findings.failure_scenario: AGENTS.md is layer 0, loaded into every session by every agent. The stale paragraph ends "When a skill tells you to run one of these and it is absent, say the gate did not run. Do not proceed as though it passed." An agent reaching M1 T6c -- which the M1 SPEC assigns to check-module.sh, not to a test -- reads line 200, concludes the gate does not exist, and reports that the module dependency surface was not checked. The gate added by this very commit is disabled by instruction. build-index.sh --check cannot catch this: it validates only the bytes between the index:gates markers, and line 200 sits outside them, which is exactly why the generated half was updated and the prose half was not. Fix is deleting `check-module.sh` from line 201's list.
